heavisideMapping.$comment: heaviside_mapping.f90:94-96 reads eta, beta; :112 aborts for an initial beta <= 0 (only the first element of an array is checked, which the schema cannot express), :116 aborts for eta outside [0, 1]. mapping_fctry.f90 accepts both type names.

solver.description: Krylov solver of the filter. Default `cg`.
solver.$comment: The coupled solvers are accepted by the factory and then abort on the first single-field solve (neko src/krylov/bcknd/cpu/cg_coupled.f90:178, via PDE_filter_mapping.f90:290). `fused_cg` aborts on a CPU build only (krylov_fctry.f90:168), so it is accepted here.
